_about: Reference distributions of EMBER2024 test files per detection model (computed on GitHub Actions with scripts/ember/dist.py): 'score' = 101 quantiles of the model score for malicious / benign files; 'feat' = per feature column, share of files where it is non-zero ('nz') and quantiles of |value| at 'quantiles' percentiles. Up to 20,000 files per class, sampled evenly over the test set.
